label: Collapse of France in 1940 as allied-support failure in the United Kingdom chart

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: The collapse of France in 1940 was shown in the United Kingdom 1801 national map by progressed Moon conjunct Saturn in the eleventh house, the house that Green ties to friendly nations.

source_assertions.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source_assertions.claim: Raphael's eleventh-house doctrine treats Parliament, allies, and national support networks under one house, so serious strain there can legitimately be read as coalition or allied-support failure rather than generic diplomacy.

notes: Phase 5 seeded alliance-stress case. Explicitly tests allied-support failure rather than generic diplomacy or war presence.

label: Atlantic Alliance strain during the 1973-1974 oil embargo

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green assigns Parliament and allies to the eleventh house and says that strong or afflicted eleventh-house conditions can show support, hostile criticism, or lack of support in national affairs and relations abroad.

source_assertions.title: Office of the Historian, Foreign Relations of the United States, 1969-1976, Volume XXXVI
source_assertions.claim: The State Department's historical preface says the 1973-1974 embargo strained the Atlantic Alliance as U.S. allies needed American help on energy while distancing themselves from U.S. Middle East policy.

notes: Phase 5 completion case for ally-network strain under resource and foreign-policy pressure rather than explicit battlefield collapse.

label: Sino-Soviet split and rupture of a major communist alliance, 1960-1961

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Green says an afflicted Moon in the eleventh can make a nation liable to lose friends abroad and places friendly nations under the eleventh house, which directly supports alliance-breakdown readings.

source_assertions.title: Britannica on the Sino-Soviet split
source_assertions.claim: Britannica describes the Sino-Soviet split as the collapse of the Sino-Soviet alliance into open ideological and strategic rivalry beginning in 1960 and sharpening through 1961.

notes: Post-Phase-5 hardening case for ally-network rupture outside the Atlantic/British frame.

label: Breakup of the United Arab Republic in 1961

source_assertions.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source_assertions.claim: Raphael places treaties, alliances, and foreign relations under the seventh house, while the eleventh covers allies and supportive political networks, allowing union rupture to be read as alliance stress.

source_assertions.title: Britannica and United Nations on the United Arab Republic breakup
source_assertions.claim: Britannica and the United Nations note that Syria withdrew from the United Arab Republic after the September 28, 1961 coup, ending the political union with Egypt.

notes: Post-Phase-5 hardening case for alliance and union rupture outside the Cold War bilateral frame.
